treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital Gains (2010; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: United Kingdom | 21.06.2010 | 28.09.2010 | 20.12.2010 | Year of Assessment 2011/2012 | BP | Yes | Yes
source_title: HK IRD Synthesised Text of the MLI and the HKSAR-UK Agreement (2010)

rates.quote: (a) except as provided in sub-paragraph (b), such dividends shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting Party of which the company paying the dividends is a resident;

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting Party in which they arise and according to the laws of that Party, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting Party, the tax so charged shall not exceed 3 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Agreement.

notes: Dividends Art. 10(2)(b): 15% cap on dividends paid out of income/gains from immovable property by an investment vehicle distributing most of that income annually with exempt property income (REIT/PAIF-type), unless the beneficial owner is a pension scheme - not modelled. INTEREST omitted: Art. 11(2) gives no general source-State cap; interest is taxable only in the residence State only if a condition in Art. 11(3) is met (beneficial owner is the other Party/subdivision/HKMA, an individual, a listed company, a pension scheme, an unrelated independent financial institution, or another company cleared by the competent authority; or interest paid by a Party/HKMA, by a bank in the ordinary course of banking business, or on a quoted Eurobond). Otherwise the source State taxes under domestic law without treaty limit. valid_from = UK income tax year from 6 April 2011 (Art. 26(2)(b)(i); corporation tax: financial years from 1 April 2011); HKSAR: YA from 1 April 2011. MLI art. 7(1) PPT replaces the main-purpose clauses in Arts 10(6), 11(7), 12(7), 20(6); MLI WHT effect HKSAR 1 April 2023, UK 1 January 2024 (ppt.from = later).
